_doc: Baseline for pmoves/tools/orphan_branch_ratchet.py. 'remote' maps branch -> {count, kind, reason}: known orphans on origin, tolerated at that count. The list may only SHRINK: a new branch or a higher count fails the ratchet, and every entry needs a non-empty reason. Regenerate with `make -C pmoves orphan-ratchet-baseline` (keeps reasons; new entries get an empty reason that fails until filled). 'local' is keyed by node id (PMOVES_NODE_ID or hostname) and is empty by design: node-side orphans are a triage queue, not a tolerance. '_exempt' names long-lived branches that are not feature branches at all.

_exempt.PMOVES.AI-Edition-Hardened: Long-lived integration branch, not a feature branch: named as a PR base in every ratchet workflow's `pull_request.branches`, so carrying commits that are not on main is what it is for. Its divergence from main is a fork-sync question, not an orphan.
_exempt.PMOVES.AI-Edition-Hardened-Integrations: Long-lived integration branch and PR base (same `pull_request.branches` lists) layered on PMOVES.AI-Edition-Hardened; not a feature branch.
